run_when: Code found opening hours, a menu page or local business data.

prompt.task: Decide whether the company is a physical or single-location operation: restaurant, bar, café, bakery, lodging, farm, retail, salon, gym, studio, clinic or trade.
prompt.definition: This lowers the score but never disqualifies.
yes_when: A physical venue with opening hours, a menu, appointments or a storefront address
no_when: The company operates online or nationwide
watch_out_for: An office address alone doesn't make it a physical business

evidence_quote.description: Exact words copied from the text. Empty when the answer is unknown.

source.description: Page name or URL the quote came from.

reason.description: One plain sentence explaining the answer.

examples.input_excerpt: Open Mon-Sat 8am-10pm. View our menu. 205 E Houston St, New York

output.reason: A restaurant with opening hours and a menu.
